# Style guide (default theme)

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-docs.py from themes/default.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

Diagrams name colours by **semantic role**; the compiler binds roles to the active theme and emits
each colour as plain opaque hex (translucent tokens are composited over paper).

| Role | Value |
|---|---|
| `paper` | `#f5f5f5` |
| `paper2` | `#ececec` |
| `ink` | `#2d3142` |
| `inkStrong` | `#111111` |
| `muted` | `#4f5d75` |
| `soft` | `#5a6580` |
| `rule` | `rgba(45,49,66,0.12)` |
| `ruleSolid` | `#bfc0c0` |
| `accent` | `#bf4520` |
| `accentTint` | `rgba(191,69,32,0.08)` |
| `link` | `#2e5aa8` |
| `nodeFill` | `#ffffff` |

## Typography

| Role | Family stack |
|---|---|
| `title` | Instrument Serif, Georgia, serif |
| `sans` | Geist, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif |
| `mono` | Geist Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace |
| `callout` | Instrument Serif, Georgia, serif |

## Contrast (WCAG, against paper)

| Role | Ratio |
|---|---|
| `ink` | 11.82:1 |
| `muted` | 6.11:1 |
| `soft` | 5.34:1 |
| `link` | 6.13:1 |
| `accent` | 4.71:1 |

## Node treatments

| Treatment | Fill | Stroke |
|---|---|---|
| `focal` (≤ 2) | accent @ 0.08 | accent, 1.2 |
| `backend` | nodeFill | ink |
| `store` | ink @ 0.05 | muted |
| `external` | ink @ 0.03 | ink @ 0.30 |
| `input` | muted @ 0.10 | soft |
| `optional` | ink @ 0.02 | ink @ 0.20, dashed 4 3 |
| `security` | accent @ 0.05 | accent @ 0.50, dashed 4 4 |
